name: Metal Cash Box
description: A small metal cash box discovered in a green locker marked NORTH at the ferry pier. The box contains a photograph of two children beside a ferry and a folded receipt indicating storage paid through Friday.
narrative_significance: A key plot device that Lena retrieves using a brass key from envelope 17. The cash box serves as a container for mysterious items—a photograph of two children and a storage receipt—that appear central to the story's mystery and Lena's mission. Its discovery and contents suggest a hidden past or secret arrangement.
